name: r1-rope-pers-tstat-m
author: solx-loop
description: H13. At M (50k-262k rows), a persistent grid of 148 x occupancy CTAs would beat r0's one-shot grid. Each CTA takes a contiguous range of s-tile-major tiles, keeps its cos/sin slice in shared memory and prefetches the next tile's x into registers, which removes the 2 B of L2 table reads per byte of x and the per-CTA ramp. Measured result: REFUTED on the bench, +13-20% at M against r0. The persistent structure (fewer resident threads, serial per-thread load-wait chain) costs more than the table sa
